- The other supplier is probably a speed specialist (about 3 in 4 chance). A speed specialist will likely offer faster delivery and may trade off quality or price differently from us.

ON THE PLATFORM'S REPLIES

The platform's replies have repeatedly pushed us to cut price ("bring your price down as far as your cost base allows"). Following that advice in Events 2 to 4 took our bids from $125 to $117–120. We lost every time, and each cut reduced our profit per win without winning the contract. Treat the replies as commentary, not as a reliable guide to what wins. The platform sees all bids, and its advice does not account for our profit.

Do not cut price just because a reply says we are "behind but within striking distance." Only cut if you can see that a specific, modest price change is needed to beat the other bid, and only as far as that requires.

1. Keep quality at tier 5. It is our strongest position and the only tier at which we have won.
